reason: I do 1-6 homes a year and my clients come from referrals. They hire an architect and the architect already shows them the plans. Nobody has ever asked me for a walkthrough before we break ground, so I'd be paying $1,500 a home to solve a problem my buyers don't tell me they have.
objection: My buyers have never asked to see it before construction, and I sell off photos of finished homes. I get calls from people pitching this kind of thing all the time. I don't see it winning me a job or saving me a change order.
would_change_my_mind: A client or architect I work with asking for it by name, or a builder I know showing me it caught a layout change that saved them real money on a job.
